events.body:
## Context

README starts with an orphaned "File Naming Convention" block, has an empty "Core Features" heading, says stats live in KV (only D1 is bound), references `app.py` and `pyproject.toml` (neither exists), clones from `github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/BLT-Lettuce.git` and shows GitHub badges.

## What to do

1. Describe D1 storage, fix the tree and clone URL, drop the badges, and move the naming-convention block under the welcome-message docs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Storage described as D1
- [ ] Every file in the tree exists
- [ ] Clone URL is git.owaspblt.org

## How to test locally

```bash
Docs only.
```

---
